sits.notes: (THIS WEEK, 8/15, WE ARE AT NC MUSEUM OF ART) Meet in front of the large silver gates on Beryl Road. Bring a cushion. Cancelled during storms. Parking on the street (please pay attention to signs)
sits.details: This is a thirty minute silent meditation. Bring your own cushion and something for underneath it is not a bad idea.  We sit together and have sangha fellowship before and after for those that choose to. Depending on the time of year, bring appropriate clothing, insect and sun protection, etc.  All are welcome.
sits.location: JC Raulston Arboretum 4415 Beryl Road, Raleigh, NC 27606

sits.day: Saturday - 8/15/26  NC Museum of Art - park
sits.notes: Bring a cushion, sun and insect protection and hydration. We meet near the welcome center on the opposite side of the parking lot from the art museum. We sit in the center grass at the top of the hill.
sits.details: This is a thirty minute silent meditation. We usually have some fellowship - Dharma discussions before and after, nice but you are welcome to come and just meditate with us. Meditating in community and in the reality of the world is a great way to get used to conditions being not under our control. Also meditating outside connect us with the natural world.
